author: Top Gear
description:
In this video, Top Gear looks at the new BMW M3. Well, one of them, because two very different new M3s are actually coming! This M Concept Neue Klasse previews how the i3-based, 1000hp+ electric M3 will look, but there will also be a petrol-powered M3 based on the next-generation 3-series.  

🚗 BMW M Concept Neue Klasse, aka the new BMW M3 Electric
🎤 Ollie Kew
